title: Finite-time blow-up for the Geng--Xue system with an application to the three-component Degasperis--Procesi system
summary: We prove finite-time blow-up for the Geng--Xue system with initial data satisfying $u_0\in W^{p,q}(\R)$ and $n_0\in L^{r'}(\R)$ at Sobolev regularity $s\geq2$, where $n=v-v_{xx}$. A cancellation in the balance law for $nu_x$ yields closed convolution estimates that do not depend on an a priori uniform bound for $u_x$. These estimates control $v$ along a characteristic and give an explicit condition on the initial slope, together with an upper bound on the lifespan. The proof does not use conservation laws.
